title: The Four Courtyards
idea: Choose a wing; broad terraces reconnect the school around Jamshid.

title: Terracotta Switchback
idea: Dash onto a raised shelf, countersteer, then transfer down through the open arch.

title: The Broken Stair
idea: Alternate leftward rise and controlled descent into the lower classroom.

title: Red Seal
idea: Brake on descending shelves, collect the seal, then dash back into daylight.

title: Lintel Run
idea: A short low-ceiling jump rhythm after the long descent.

title: Windcatcher
idea: Cross the shaft in three ascending diagonal transfers.

title: Windward Walls
idea: Alternate wall jumps up the windcatcher, then transfer onto the upper arch.

title: Green Seal
idea: A descending aerial key line with a safe landing before the return shaft.

title: Falling Leaves
idea: Steer between staggered shelves; the same route supports a retreat upward.

title: Qanat Descent
idea: Drop into water, swim under the first baffle and over the second, then land dry.

title: Two Breaths
idea: A dry landing separates two submerged direction changes.

title: Blue Seal
idea: Climb out of the last pool, then use a dry diagonal dash to reach the key.

title: The Dry Well
idea: A compact rising countersteer sequence returns to the courtyard.

title: Gilded Rhythm
idea: Three committed landings join two broad safe ends.

title: The High Note
idea: Ascend away from the exit, then deliberately drop back to it.

title: Gold Seal
idea: Catch a descending crumble chain and brake on the seal terrace.

title: Last Bell
idea: Alternate high and low catches before the safe hub.
